chase: Target is moving. Logging the direction and the speed.
Pursuit confirmed. Staying on the same line as you.
For the record, running does not change the result.
I am not fast. I am correct, which is slower but sure.
Your path bends left. I will take the shorter line.
Following the trail of your footsteps. Each one is counted.
Closing the gap now. Four rooms is the current distance.
Chasing in a straight line. That is the efficient route.
Route confirmed. You turned twice, so I adjusted twice.
Target in sight. Distance is four, and dropping.
You cannot out-count me. I track every door you pass.
Rule one. Anyone running in my hall is in my record.
Pursuit is a process, not a sprint. Continuing.
You are still in range. Range is short, and so is your lead.
Stay in view and this ends with a catch.
Sprinting now. This is outside my normal pace, noted.
I have not lost you. The record shows the corner you took.
Pursuit still active. Your route is on the log.
Tracking speed and bearing. Keep running, please.
You ducked behind the stand. Logged and followed.
catch: Caught. Time and room logged for the report.
Target secured. Escorting you back to the lobby.
Contact made. You are being removed from the route.
Caught. Recording the result as a clean catch.
You are held now. Stillness saves us both time.
Catch recorded. The count for this floor is updated.
Got you. The notebook gets the time and the room.
Removal in progress. This is procedure, not anger.
You are out of the route for now. Noted.
One of you is caught. The rest, keep your distance.
Dragged clear of the door. Logged as standard removal.
Taken to the lobby. The route will reset without you.
Another catch for the sheet. Neat, and quick.
You are taken. The rules do not allow an argument.
Caught at the stairs. Recording the landing as the spot.
Grabbed. Hold still while I finish the record.
Target secured. Logging the exact time now.
Capture recorded. Escorting you to the lobby.
Caught in the corridor, timestamp noted. Walk on.
hear: Noise logged from the east hall. Investigating now.
A door just opened. Logging it, then going to check.
Something broke in the lounge. Moving there at once.
Footsteps, two sets, from upstairs. Checking the landing.
A shout from the kitchen. Recording the time first.
Movement in the lounge. Proceeding at the posted pace.
That was a door. Doors are on my list. Moving.
Sound confirmed at the far end. Approaching quietly.
Noise near the vents. Investigating the source now.
A crash behind the stairs. Checking that spot first.
The sound came from room nine. Moving to check.
Heard a drawer close. Filing it under possible movement.
One click at the door. I have it logged.
Something moved behind the shelf. Investigating that corner.
Two sounds, then silence. Going to the last one.
Sound logged from the storage room. Investigating.
Second noise from the balcony. Logging it now.
A cabinet closed on the east side. Checking.
search: Lost you. Filing it as a temporary loss, not a finding.
Lost sight at the bend. Checking the last point I saw.
Searching the last known spot. Checking each door in order.
No contact for a while. Widening the search pattern.
Your trail ends here. Checking the rooms around it.
Sweeping the hall in a grid. Every door counts.
Nothing in the closet. Nothing under the desk. Continuing.
The count is off by one. Searching until it matches.
Returning to patrol. The search is closed for now.
Patrol resumes. Your position stays open in the record.
Lost you at the stairs. Checking the landing twice.
Searching the lounge again. You may have doubled back.
No sign in the hall. Expanding the search to the east.
Target unseen. Keeping a count of the doors I check.
Going back to patrol. The file stays open, though.
stunned: Stunned. Pausing the record until my systems settle.
That was a taser hit. Logging it as an interruption.
Crowbar contact. Recalibrating, one moment please.
Stunned for the record. Recovery takes a moment.
Impact logged. Position held until I recover.
Interruption logged. Resuming in a moment.
I am held in place. Standing by while I reset.
That axe hit counts as an interruption. Noted.
Stun confirmed. My position is fixed for now.
Recovering now. The count restarts from this second.
My route is delayed. The delay is in the record.
Shaking it off. This will not be repeated.
Stunned again. This is the second entry tonight.
The taser hit was clean. Recovering at the posted pace.
I was struck. Recovery is slower than the record wants.
hide_spot: Hiding spot checked. Occupied, I believe. Checking again.
You are behind the crate. Recording the crate as occupied.
Good hiding. The rules do not forbid it, so I allow it.
Locker is marked occupied. Opening it now, slowly.
Under the bed. Recording it as a hiding spot.
Wardrobe checked. The count goes up by one.
The closet is occupied. Stay very still, please.
Your spot is on my sheet. I am checking the edges.
Edges checked. Under the bed, then the locker.
Hiding is allowed. Hiding is still tracked.
I see a shoe under the bed. Checking that first.
Passing the locker. Logging it as occupied for now.
The bed looks occupied. Checking it now.
Locker door is shut. Counting the vents above it.
Every hiding spot is a line on my sheet. Yours too.
light: Your flashlight just swept my corner. Logged as a sighting.
Your lights are on. That makes you easy to record.
Light in my eyes. Logging it as an unfair sighting.
That beam is very bright. Recording the glare.
I am dazzled. Please point that flashlight at the floor.
Put the flashlight down. Your beam is blinding my sensors.
The lamp is on. My count is paused until it dims.
Too much light in this room. My count is blurred.
Flashlight in my face. The rules say nothing about this.
The lights went off. I can still count your steps.
Bright light on my face. I will move out of it.
Lamp on in the lounge. That was a bad choice.
Your beam is a poor choice for your position.
The light is pointing my way again. Adjusting.
Dazzled for a moment. Cover is only one step away.
Glare in my sensors. Stepping sideways to recover.
idle: Breakfast was at the same time. I wrote that down too.
I measured the lounge rug again. The result stands.
I counted the rooms upstairs twice. Once in pencil.
Pencil only. Ink suggests a finality I do not have.
A clean sheet of paper calms me before a shift.
The edges of every room go in the margin, very small.
Every doorway in the house is written down. Every one.
My notebook has a column for things to report. Mostly empty.
Rule nine. Keep a reserve of pencils for the field.
Rule four. Walk the stairs. Do not slide down them.
Patrol on the second floor. Nothing to report yet.
The watch sheet is filling up. Slowly, as it should.
Resting for one minute. The minute is recorded too.
Tea was cold and on time. Noting both of those.
I am writing the round down while it happens.
The loop is complete. Starting the count from the door.
ability: I have placed a lattice frame over the junction ahead.
A frame is set. Crossing it tells me where you were.
Frame armed. I will know where you cross, not where you go.
One step over the line and my record updates itself.
I hold still while the frame settles. Do not mistake that for rest.
The floor is my ledger, and every frame is an entry in it.
Each frame costs me a pause. I make the pause count.
My frame waits for a foot, and then it reports.
Cooldown lasts four seconds. I use it to plan the next frame.
Frame placed. Its position is mine to know, not yours.
Frames are never placed on safe zones, relays or hiding spots.
Frame up. It stays live for six seconds, then it clears.
Frame up. It is invisible to you, and I will not say where.
Survey complete. Holding still while I choose a line.
Frame goes down under your feet. It is not invisible to me.
mechanic: You took a relay and ran. The relay is logged as taken.
The three relays are logged, and each one is correct.
Relay is clear. Tell the others it is safe to go.
You dropped into the vent. That is outside the route.
That door was locked. You opened it anyway. Logged.
You are on the stairs. I have the hall and the frame.
You went up the stairs. Moving to the landing after you.
Item taken from the shelf. Logging it under supplies.
Fall detected. Recording the drop and the floor below.
Breaker tripped near the lounge. Logging the cause.
Vent cover is loose. Rule six says check every vent.
Relay station is down. Route tasks are delayed, not canceled.
Lever pulled at the lounge door. Logged as a change.
The vent is open. I will count every crawl through it.
Stairs are now the only route. Logging the change.
Relay logged as taken. Battery log is next.
Radar log updated. The lobby relay is marked.
